source_rights_status: Cleared display sources only: FAOSTAT and UN Comtrade (cut roses)
caveats: Year grid is not observed coverage. Missing values remain null wherever TCL has no observation; cut roses use Comtrade World totals.
Rice macro trade uses FAOSTAT TCL items 31 (Rice, milled) and 32 (Rice, broken) summed; paddy rice (item 27) and production are excluded.
Sugar TCL code 164 is refined sugar, not raw sugar or sugarcane. FBS is raw equivalent.
FBS is in 1000 tonnes, TCL quantities in tonnes, TCL values in 1000 USD. FBS aggregates are kept in separate columns.

Signed apparent_balance_t retains negative accounting residuals. net_supply_t and dependency are null for negative balances, pending stock/calendar reconciliation. Supply excludes stocks; dependency ratio is computed only for maize, wheat, dry beans, green coffee and avocados with matching production. No unverified paddy/milled or green/made tea conversion.
CBK export values in KES remain separate from TCL USD. FX is mean of 12 monthly averages, not a transaction-weighted conversion.
Pink Sheet prices are benchmarks, not Kenya realized prices. Nominal values require price and exchange-rate controls before climate association analysis.
Horticulture totals are published separately in kenya_horticulture_exports.parquet; cannot be assigned to flowers/avocados.

commodity_id.description: Standardized commodity identifier in national basket

commodity_label.description: Human-readable commodity display name with scope note

category.description: Broad commodity category: Staple or Export

production_t.description: National agricultural production quantity on matching product basis
production_t.null_semantics: null where product definition does not match macro trade or observation absent
production_t.lineage: FAOSTAT QCL via faostat.parquet or kenya_trade_production.parquet

net_supply_t.description: Apparent domestic supply (production + imports - exports) where balance is non-negative
net_supply_t.null_semantics: null where production or trade inputs are incomplete, or apparent balance is negative

apparent_balance_t.description: Signed apparent balance retaining negative accounting residuals
apparent_balance_t.null_semantics: null where production or trade inputs are incomplete

supply_status.description: Qualitative status of apparent supply accounting
supply_status.lineage: Derived from apparent_balance_t sign and component completeness

import_dependency_pct.null_semantics: null where net_supply_t is null or non-positive, or for export crops

imports_t.description: Total annual import volume in metric tonnes
imports_t.null_semantics: null where trade is not reported or observed
imports_t.lineage: FAOSTAT TCL element 5610, or UN Comtrade World for cut roses

exports_t.description: Total annual export volume in metric tonnes
exports_t.null_semantics: null where trade is not reported or observed
exports_t.lineage: FAOSTAT TCL element 5910, or UN Comtrade World for cut roses

import_value_usd.description: Total annual import value in nominal US dollars
import_value_usd.null_semantics: null where trade is not reported or observed
import_value_usd.lineage: FAOSTAT TCL element 5622 (converted from 1000 USD), or UN Comtrade World

export_value_usd.description: Total annual export value in nominal US dollars
export_value_usd.null_semantics: null where trade is not reported or observed
export_value_usd.lineage: FAOSTAT TCL element 5922 (converted from 1000 USD), or UN Comtrade World

trade_source.description: Primary dataset source for trade flow observations
trade_source.lineage: Source identifier: FAOSTAT TCL or UN Comtrade

comtrade_weight_estimated.description: Flag indicating whether net weight was estimated by UN Comtrade
comtrade_weight_estimated.null_semantics: null for FAOSTAT sources; boolean for UN Comtrade cut roses

unit_import_price_usd_t.description: Implied unit import value in nominal USD per metric tonne
unit_import_price_usd_t.null_semantics: null where import volume or value is absent or volume is zero

unit_export_price_usd_t.description: Implied unit export value in nominal USD per metric tonne
unit_export_price_usd_t.null_semantics: null where export volume or value is absent or volume is zero

fbs_production_t.description: Food Balance Sheet production aggregate (separate commodity scope)
fbs_production_t.null_semantics: null where FBS has no observation or commodity not in FBS

fbs_imports_t.description: Food Balance Sheet import aggregate (separate commodity scope)
fbs_imports_t.null_semantics: null where FBS has no observation or commodity not in FBS

fbs_exports_t.description: Food Balance Sheet export aggregate (separate commodity scope)
fbs_exports_t.null_semantics: null where FBS has no observation or commodity not in FBS

fbs_domestic_supply_t.description: Food Balance Sheet domestic supply quantity (separate commodity scope)
fbs_domestic_supply_t.null_semantics: null where FBS has no observation or commodity not in FBS

fbs_stock_variation_t.description: Food Balance Sheet stock variation quantity (separate commodity scope)
fbs_stock_variation_t.null_semantics: null where FBS has no observation or commodity not in FBS

fbs_product_scope.description: FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheet item description
fbs_product_scope.null_semantics: null where commodity not in FBS

tcl_item_code.description: FAOSTAT Trade Crops and Livestock Products item code(s)
tcl_item_code.null_semantics: null for commodities sourced outside TCL (e.g. cut roses)

tcl_flags.description: FAOSTAT observation quality flags by element code
tcl_flags.null_semantics: null where no TCL observation exists

fbs_flags.description: FAOSTAT Food Balance Sheet observation quality flags by element code
fbs_flags.null_semantics: null where no FBS observation exists

trade_observed.description: Boolean flag indicating whether any trade flow was observed for commodity-year
trade_observed.lineage: Derived: any of imports_t, exports_t, import_value_usd, export_value_usd not null

coverage_note.description: Temporal and source coverage status note
